quizName: DMV Practice Test #4 25 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: Riding next to a car:

options.text: Can put you in a blind spot.
Is not a problem unless the road is wet.
Can make driving easier for the other driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can put you in a blind spot.
questions.explanation: Riding directly next to another vehicle is dangerous. The driver may not see you in their blind spot. Also, the vehicle blocks your way to escape.

questions.question: What type of sign is yellow with black letters or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: Check your motorcycle:
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need more frequent checks than cars. Check your motorcycle completely before every ride.

questions.question: Waiting one hour after one drink before riding:

options.text: Means you cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Means your riding skills will not be affected.
Is fine as long as you ride slowly.
May not completely remove alcohol from your body.

questions.correctAnswerText: May not completely remove alcohol from your body.
questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink per hour. However, this varies from person to person. It is safest not to ride after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: What is often found in the center of the lane?
questions.explanation: Oil drips from cars form a greasy strip in the center of lanes. When the road is dry, it is usually safe for motorcycles to use this center strip.

questions.question: The best source of information about your motorcycle is:

options.text: Someone who owns a different type of motorcycle.
A television show about motorcycle riding.

questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are borrowing someone else's motorcycle.

questions.question: If a friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Tell them to take less-crowded roads.
Get other friends to talk them out of riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get other friends to talk them out of riding.
questions.explanation: Never allow someone who has been drinking to ride. Do everything you can to stop them. Ask other friends to help convince them not to ride.

questions.question: The body removes about one drink per hour. If someone drank eight drinks four hours ago, how many drinks are likely still in their body?
questions.explanation: Subtract the hours since drinking from the number of drinks consumed. Eight drinks minus four hours equals four drinks still in the system.

questions.question: What reduces the risk of head or neck injury in a crash?
questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet is the best way to protect your head and neck in a crash.

questions.question: Riding gloves should:

options.text: Not be worn because they make your hands too hot.
Be worn to grip the handlebars better.
Not be worn because they make controls harder to use.
Be worn only on cool days.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be worn to grip the handlebars better.
questions.explanation: Wear leather or durable gloves when riding. They give you a better grip on the handlebars and protect your hands in a crash.

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?
questions.explanation: Bright and reflective clothing helps others see you anytime. Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day, so wear bright clothes all the time.

questions.question: What happens if your motorcycle's chain or belt breaks?

options.text: The rear wheel suddenly gets more power.
The rear wheel suddenly loses power.
The front wheel suddenly loses power.
The front wheel suddenly gets more power.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rear wheel suddenly loses power.
questions.explanation: If your drive chain or belt breaks, power to the rear wheel stops immediately.

questions.question: When should you use a turn signal?

options.text: When you plan to speed up.
Every time you plan to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Every time you plan to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Use a turn signal every time you turn or change lanes, even if no one else is nearby.

questions.question: What is one way to lower your crash risk?

options.text: Tell other drivers what you plan to do.
Ride in spots where others cannot see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell other drivers what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: Lower your crash risk by staying visible. Use signals, your brake light, and good lane position. Keep space around your bike and watch the road ahead, behind, and beside you.

questions.question: When does alcohol start to impair your ability to ride?
questions.explanation: Even one drink can affect your riding ability. You can be impaired well below the legal limit. Never drink and ride.

questions.question: What is the proper body position on a motorcycle?

options.text: Sit forward enough that your arms bend slightly when holding the grips.
Sit as far back as possible and stretch to reach the grips.
Lean forward so your arms hold you up.
Keep your knees far from the gas tank.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sit forward enough that your arms bend slightly when holding the grips.
questions.explanation: Sit far enough forward so your arms bend slightly when you grip the handlebars. This position lets you reach and use the controls easily.

questions.question: Is riding at night easier or harder than riding during the day?

options.text: Easier, because you can see other vehicles' lights better.
It is not allowed on highways.

questions.explanation: Night riding is harder because you cannot see as well and others cannot see you as well. Darkness also makes it harder to judge distances.

questions.question: If you borrow a motorcycle, what should you do?

options.text: Expect it to handle like your bike.
Trust that the owner checked the brakes.
Leave extra space between you and other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave extra space between you and other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Check an unfamiliar motorcycle the same way you check your own. Ride carefully and keep extra space to give yourself more time to stop.

questions.question: What should you wear to help other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors to make yourself more visible to other drivers. Choose clothes that stand out both day and night.

questions.question: If your motorcycle suddenly handles differently, what should you do?

options.text: Pull over and check the tires.
Pull over and check the chain.
Pull over and check the windshield.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over and check the tires.
questions.explanation: A sudden change in handling usually means a tire has failed. If your bike handles differently, pull over safely and check your tires.

questions.question: When riding an unfamiliar motorcycle, what should you do?

options.text: Test the seat to make sure it is comfortable.
Assume the motorcycle is in good condition.
Practice using the throttle, clutch, and brakes before you ride.
Ride normally, since all bikes work the same way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Practice using the throttle, clutch, and brakes before you ride.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before you ride, get to know the bike. Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes to learn how they work.

questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, what should you do?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you stay awake.
Stop and rest away from the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest away from the road.
questions.explanation: Do not ride when you are tired. On long trips, take a rest break every two hours to prevent fatigue.

questions.question: What does a plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protect you from?
questions.explanation: A face shield protects your face from injury in a crash and shields you from wind, dust, dirt, rain, insects, and pebbles.

questions.question: Which sign is rectangular in shape?
questions.explanation: Speed limit and other regulation signs are rectangular with white backgrounds and black text or symbols. You must follow the rules on these signs.

questions.question: Which fabric offers the most protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants give riders the best protection.
